one_liner: AI-powered web scraping and data extraction platform with a REST API and MCP server.
auth_notes: API tokens are managed from the dashboard and passed in the x-api-token header, or as a Bearer token for marketplace endpoints.
access_notes: Sign up for the free tier providing 1,000 tokens (or 100 tokens per month free plan) with no credit card required.
api_notes: REST API covering scrapers, unblocker, analytics, and platform management under api.app.mrscraper.com/api/v1.
blocker_notes: Fully available with self-serve free tier and documented public API.

auth.quote: Include your API token in the x-api-token HTTP header on every request: x-api-token: <MRSCRAPER_API_TOKEN>

access.quote: The Free plan includes 100 tokens per month with no credit card required. Tokens reset at the beginning of each month.

api.quote: The MrScraper API provides a powerful and flexible way to programmatically scrape web pages and retrieve structured data. Built on REST principles, our API offers predictable resource-oriented URLs

mcp.quote: Official MrScraper MCP server for web scraping, structured data extraction, and Google search. Connect AI clients or run the open-source server locally.

verdict.quote: The Free plan includes 100 tokens per month with no credit card required.
